records.name: 白鸡
records.title: Chicken
records.acquisition: 在玛妮牧场购买鸡：800金，购买时随机分配颜色；白鸡蛋或大鸡蛋也可孵化白鸡。
records.effect: 每天产白色鸡蛋，友好度与心情足够时可能产大鸡蛋。
records.restriction: 孵化需要大鸡舍或高级鸡舍的孵化器，且建筑必须留有动物名额。
records.versionEvidence: 1.6: Eggs now always give the corresponding color of chicken in the Incubator. Blue chickens can now only be obtained from Marnie's Ranch.  Native Data/FarmAnimals SHA-256 84FBCB80E492B6C2C6E09F16A1D4D92BBB1081FEE917EBFD6297BE3C4815BE65

records.name: 褐鸡
records.title: Chicken
records.acquisition: 在玛妮牧场购买鸡：800金，购买时随机分配颜色；褐色蛋及对应大蛋可孵化褐鸡。
records.effect: 每天产褐色鸡蛋，友好度与心情足够时可能产褐色大鸡蛋。
records.restriction: 1.6孵化按蛋的颜色决定鸡的颜色；孵化器和鸡舍空位均不可缺少。
records.versionEvidence: 1.6: Eggs now always give the corresponding color of chicken in the Incubator. Blue chickens can now only be obtained from Marnie's Ranch.  Native Data/FarmAnimals SHA-256 84FBCB80E492B6C2C6E09F16A1D4D92BBB1081FEE917EBFD6297BE3C4815BE65

records.name: 蓝鸡
records.title: Chicken
records.acquisition: 看过谢恩8心事件后，在玛妮牧场购买鸡（800金）时有25%机会获得蓝鸡。
records.effect: 每天产白色鸡蛋，不会产蓝色蛋；颜色不同不代表产蛋价格或周期提高。
records.restriction: 1.6不能通过孵化获得蓝鸡；未触发谢恩事件时，反复买鸡也不能绕过解锁。
records.versionEvidence: 1.6: Eggs now always give the corresponding color of chicken in the Incubator. Blue chickens can now only be obtained from Marnie's Ranch.  Native Data/FarmAnimals SHA-256 84FBCB80E492B6C2C6E09F16A1D4D92BBB1081FEE917EBFD6297BE3C4815BE65

records.name: 虚空鸡
records.title: Void Chicken
records.acquisition: 将虚空蛋放入鸡舍孵化器，并保留动物空位；不能直接在玛妮牧场购买虚空鸡。
records.effect: 每天产虚空蛋，可继续孵化或加工虚空蛋黄酱，不会产普通大鸡蛋。
records.restriction: 先取得虚空蛋再孵化；孵化时间与出生后的成熟期是两段不同的等待。
records.versionEvidence: Present in original 1.6.15 Data/FarmAnimals. Native Data/FarmAnimals SHA-256 84FBCB80E492B6C2C6E09F16A1D4D92BBB1081FEE917EBFD6297BE3C4815BE65

records.name: 金鸡
records.title: Golden Chicken
records.acquisition: 将金蛋放入鸡舍孵化器，并保留动物空位；金蛋获取条件另见金蛋资料，不是普通鸡随机变色。
records.effect: 每天产金蛋；一枚金蛋可加工3份金星蛋黄酱，不能按普通鸡蛋的单份产量估算。
records.restriction: 必须先取得金蛋，不能用普通鸡蛋孵出；建筑和孵化器需要满足条件。

records.name: 鸭
records.title: Duck
records.acquisition: 玛妮牧场购买：1,200金；也可以将鸭蛋放入鸡舍孵化器，前提是有动物空位。
records.effect: 每2天产鸭蛋，友好度和心情足够时可能改产鸭毛，不是每天同时给两种产品。
records.restriction: 鸭子能游泳，但收集鸭蛋与鸭毛仍需要关注生产周期和当天动物状态。
records.versionEvidence: 1.5: Lowered purchase price from data-sort-value="4000">4,000g to data-sort-value="1200">1,200g. Increased Duck Feather price from data-sort-value="125">125g to data-sort-value="250">250g. Ducks can now swim in water. 1.5.2: Lowered sell price from data-sort-value="5200">5,200g to data-sort-value="1560">1,560g.  Native Data/FarmAnimals SHA-256 84FBCB80E492B6C2C6E09F16A1D4D92BBB1081FEE917EBFD6297BE3C4815BE65

records.name: 兔子
records.title: Rabbit
records.acquisition: 在玛妮牧场以8,000金购买，并安排高级鸡舍空位；不是将兔子的脚放入孵化器。
records.effect: 每4天掉落动物毛；状态足够好时可能改产兔子的脚，不需要用剪刀剪毛。
records.restriction: 兔子不会繁殖；兔子的脚不能靠宰杀或孵化取得，不能保证每次都产出。
records.versionEvidence: Present in original 1.6.15 Data/FarmAnimals. Native Data/FarmAnimals SHA-256 84FBCB80E492B6C2C6E09F16A1D4D92BBB1081FEE917EBFD6297BE3C4815BE65

records.name: 恐龙
records.title: Dinosaur
records.acquisition: 将恐龙蛋放入鸡舍孵化器，建筑要有空位；孵化完成即成熟，不在玛妮牧场出售。
records.effect: 每7天产恐龙蛋，可留种孵化或加工恐龙蛋黄酱，不是可战斗的喷火怪物。
records.restriction: 孵化时间不等于成熟天数：恐龙出壳后已成熟，但仍需按饲养条件等待产蛋。
records.versionEvidence: 1.0: Introduced. 1.2.26: Fixed bug where they wouldn't produce goods at high happiness. 1.4: Fixed bug allowing wallpaper #108 to be placed in an incubator in lieu of a Dinosaur Egg. 1.6: A new dialogue interaction was added with Demetrius for hatching a dinosaur. Additionally, a new book of power interaction increases the value of unprocessed dinosaur eggs.  Native Data/FarmAnimals SHA-256 84FBCB80E492B6C2C6E09F16A1D4D92BBB1081FEE917EBFD6297BE3C4815BE65

records.name: 白牛
records.title: Cow
records.acquisition: 在玛妮牧场以1,500金购买牛，白色或褐色随机；有条件时也可通过畜棚生育增加数量。
records.effect: 每天产牛奶，状态足够好时产大壶牛奶；用挤奶桶或自动采集器收集。
records.restriction: 颜色不改变牛奶种类；不能将牛奶放入孵化器，应保留畜棚空位并喂食。
records.versionEvidence: Present in original 1.6.15 Data/FarmAnimals. Native Data/FarmAnimals SHA-256 84FBCB80E492B6C2C6E09F16A1D4D92BBB1081FEE917EBFD6297BE3C4815BE65

records.name: 褐牛
records.title: Cow
records.acquisition: 在玛妮牧场以1,500金购买牛，白色或褐色随机；有条件时也可通过畜棚生育增加数量。
records.effect: 每天产牛奶，状态足够好时产大壶牛奶；与白牛产出相同，不产褐色牛奶。
records.restriction: 颜色不改变牛奶种类；用挤奶桶或自动采集器收集，不是直接掉落在地面。
records.versionEvidence: Present in original 1.6.15 Data/FarmAnimals. Native Data/FarmAnimals SHA-256 84FBCB80E492B6C2C6E09F16A1D4D92BBB1081FEE917EBFD6297BE3C4815BE65

records.name: 山羊
records.title: Goat
records.acquisition: 在玛妮牧场以4,000金购买，并安排大畜棚或高级畜棚空位；可以在条件满足时生育。
records.effect: 每2天产羊奶，状态足够好时产大瓶羊奶；用挤奶桶或自动采集器收集。
records.restriction: 不要按奶牛的每日周期安排羊奶；成熟、喂食与生产周期都需要满足。
records.versionEvidence: Present in original 1.6.15 Data/FarmAnimals. Native Data/FarmAnimals SHA-256 84FBCB80E492B6C2C6E09F16A1D4D92BBB1081FEE917EBFD6297BE3C4815BE65

records.name: 绵羊
records.title: Sheep
records.acquisition: 在玛妮牧场以8,000金购买，并安排高级畜棚空位；剪刀或自动采集器用于收毛。
records.effect: 基础每3天长出动物毛；满足亲密度与牧羊人职业条件时可以缩短周期。
records.restriction: 需喂食且心情至少70；友好度至少900减少1天，牧羊人再减少1天，两者叠加可每天产毛。
records.versionEvidence: 1.0: Introduced. 1.2.26: Fixed bug where they wouldn't produce goods at high happiness.  Native Data/FarmAnimals SHA-256 84FBCB80E492B6C2C6E09F16A1D4D92BBB1081FEE917EBFD6297BE3C4815BE65

records.name: 猪
records.title: Pig
records.acquisition: 在玛妮牧场以16,000金购买，并安排高级畜棚空位；成熟后需能出门活动才能寻找松露。
records.effect: 满足条件时在室外寻找松露，数量并非每天固定；不会在畜棚内直接掉落成品。
records.restriction: 冬季和雨天不找松露；需喂食、放出畜棚且有可用空地，不能按每日固定产量承诺收益。
records.versionEvidence: 1.0: Introduced. 1.2.26: Fixed bug where they wouldn't produce goods at high happiness. 1.5: Crafted flooring/paths no longer prevent pigs from producing truffles. 1.6: Can now rarely dig up Truffle Crabs.  Native Data/FarmAnimals SHA-256 84FBCB80E492B6C2C6E09F16A1D4D92BBB1081FEE917EBFD6297BE3C4815BE65

records.name: 鸵鸟
records.title: Ostrich
records.acquisition: 将鸵鸟蛋放入畜棚内的鸵鸟孵化器，普通鸡舍孵化器无效；畜棚需有动物空位。
records.effect: 每7天产鸵鸟蛋；一枚蛋可加工10份同品质蛋黄酱，不能按普通鸡蛋计算。
records.restriction: 鸵鸟孵化器配方与首枚鸵鸟蛋分别获取；先解决孵化条件，再规划每周产蛋。
